programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: In Texas, everything's bigger, except the hiding spots, and K9 Enzo proves it, locking onto a suspect wedged beneath a house; on the graveyard shift, rookie K9 Deebo steps up and shows he's the real deal; in Florida, officers shut down traffic for a high-stakes helicopter landing, rushing K9 Huk to an emergency hospital; elsewhere, K9 Diesel plunges headfirst into dark waters in pursuit of a suspect and K9 Vinnie is deployed to take down a dangerous suspect hurling Molotov cocktails.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Fresh out of the academy, rookie K9 Carrier gets the call, but can he score his first apprehension?; in a pounding downpour, K9 Flash stays locked on the scent, tracking a suspect who bolted even after being tasered.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Just months from retirement, K9 Tasja is sent into a sprawling hotel with over 140 rooms, endless hiding spots and one suspect who refuses to be found; in another urgent search, K9 Midnight is called in to find a missing boy.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When a suspect makes it clear he's not stopping for anyone, it's up to K9 Murphy's speed and determination to bring the chase to an end; K9 Bear's bomb-detection training is suddenly put to the test when explosives detonate in the middle of the night; after eluding police for weeks, a naked fugitive is on the run again; K9 Eddie is called in, and the pursuit ends exactly as his training predicts; and K9 Red barrels into action after a suspect crashes into a police cruiser and then tears off.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: K9 Duke puts his elite agility on full display with a high-risk takedown that ends a lengthy standoff in seconds. Vegas PD pulls out all the stops to save one of their own, after a desperate suspect turns violent and attacks K9 Enzo. K9 Carrier proves once again that when his nose is on the job, there's nowhere left to run and nowhere left to hide. And even after his handler takes a hard fall, K9 Jedi stays locked in relentlessly pursuing and capturing a fleeing suspect.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When suspects make a run, K9 teams prove why the nose always knows; rookie K9 Duder gets thrown into the deep end when a high-speed chase explodes into a full-blown foot pursuit; after breaking into a store, a desperate suspect plays a dangerous game of hide-and-seek with K9 Ice; K9 Chico kicks into turbo mode, tracking down a fleeing suspect with a backpack stuffed with drugs; K9 Dobby sniffs out a woman accused of double murder.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: As the sun goes down in a quiet farm town, K9 Rico is deployed to track down a man accused of strangling his neighbor; meanwhile, K9 Clooney springs into action when a desperate suspect makes a bold, shocking move-stealing a police cruiser in a last-ditch attempt to escape; K9 Murphy teams up with the aviation unit, combining forces in a relentless search for a suspect who fled after leading officers on a nearly 100-mile chase.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: K9 Lord and his handler are award-winning trackers-but this call is more than just skill, it's about teamwork as they push the pursuit over a fence and close in on a suspect; meanwhile, K9 Bingo chases down an allegedly armed suspect who has fled into a crowded public park; in the dead of night, K9 Odin searches for the driver of a reported stolen vehicle and K9 Holmes and Baro tag team to help flush out and capture two suspects hiding deep in the woods.
